name: icon-button
description: Icon-only action that must say its name. Presses, refuses a double tap, and overlays a spinner without shrinking.
avoidWhen: Do not use when the action has a visible label; use button.

ux.behaviour: contentDescription is required; TalkBack always has a name
ux.why: A silent icon is a dead control

ux.behaviour: The target is 48 dp, scales to 0.97 while pressed, and fires a click haptic
ux.why: You feel the tap land on a small target
ux.reducedMotion: No scale; ripple and haptic only

ux.behaviour: A second tap within 400 ms is ignored; taps are ignored while loading
ux.why: Nobody fires twice because the network was slow

ux.behaviour: The spinner appears after 150 ms and stays at least 500 ms; the icon stays at alpha 0 so the hit target never shrinks
ux.why: A fast call is just fast; a slow one shows one steady spinner

aiHints: Always pass a localized contentDescription; there is no default
Keep enabled as the caller's enabled; ignore clicks while loading instead of setting enabled = false
